about_the_game:
Game Features

  • Visual novel gameplay driven by narrative choices

  • Gender selection available + name customization

  • 20+ illustrated characters, 4 story branches, 10+ distinct endings

  • Expansive branching choices forge your unique journey

  • Exploration mechanics unveil truths through fragmented storytelling

Story Synopsis

When war between the Enhanced and ordinary humans tears the future apart, rewriting history becomes humanity's final gamble. As a life scientist from the New Epoch, you return to the catastrophe's eve to eliminate genetic disparity through research. Your choices may redeem both timelines, sacrifice one for the other... or plunge all into the abyss.

Story Features

  • Themes: Sci-Fi / Enhanced Abilities / Dual Timelines / Dystopia

  • Navigate Two Eras: 21st century (Old Epoch) & 22nd century (New Epoch)

  • Dual Identities:
    - Public persona: Compassionate health specialist
    - Hidden self: Ruthless scientist with elite combat prowess

Beta Test Announcement

This initial test features the complete Prologue chapter (First playthrough), with 2-3 hours of gameplay including:

- 50,000 words of narrative content

- 14 character illustrations (11 unique characters)

- 1 exclusive CG

Key Test Content:

  • Core Character Introductions

    - 4 pivotal NPC debuts (Gioia, Léon, Sosa, Lynn)

    - Each characters at least one complete story arc

  • Worldbuilding Systems

    - Full dual-timeline foundational lore

    - Unlocks [Glossary] system functionality

  • Complex Branching Narrative (per segment)

    - 6 story path variations

    - 3 main endings

    - 1 Game Over ending

  • Exploration Gameplay

    - 3 investigation segments (1 triggerable via choices)

content_descriptors.notes: This game explores complex moral dilemmas that may exceed the comprehension of younger audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WIN7 SP1 / WIN8 / WIN10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel CORE i3-3200 or above
  • Graphics: GT750 or above
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: WIN7 SP1 / WIN8 / WIN10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: intel CORE i5-4460 or above
  • Graphics: GTX980 or above
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A sci-fi visual novel. You will play as a life scientist sent from the future to perform clandestine research on transforming ordinary humans into the Enhanced.Force genetic equality or embrace natural selection? Your choices will determine the fate of two timelines.
